verdict.rationale: Rollbar publishes a first-party API reference at docs.rollbar.com/reference. It has per-endpoint pages, such as list-all-items with the `get https://api.rollbar.com/api/1/items` method/URL and example queries for paging and filtering, and is backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, which supports an explorable reference. However, no evidence shows an interactive 'try it' console or runnable request examples. missing for 10: explicit evidence of interactive in-browser request execution (try-it/runnable examples), multi-language code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference's interactivity.
